name: Moto Guzzi 850T / T3 / Convert
engine: 844 cc air-cooled 90-degree V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive, linked brakes
intro: Guzzi's 850 tourers. Linked brakes on the T3, a torque-converter automatic on the Convert.

K: Guzzi big twins use a car-type dry clutch and a separate gearbox and final drive. Change all three oils, not just the engine oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
